topic: Antenna Design for PLC in High-Noise Environments
consensus_response: DLB's proposed approach provides a comprehensive framework for designing antennas for reliable power line communication in challenging environments.  Key considerations include noise source identification, mitigation strategies, antenna optimization, performance metrics, practical implementation, emerging technologies, and regulatory landscape.  Case studies provide real-world examples of the successful implementation of these strategies.
reference_context: The discussion covered various aspects of antenna design for PLC in high-noise environments, including mitigation strategies, system-level considerations, performance metrics, practical implementation, emerging technologies, and regulatory challenges.
